rocket.stage3_proxy_nozzle_reference_note: Thies reports nozzle clearance as distance from nozzle end to landing pad. The Stage 3A proxy does not include CAD nozzle coordinates, so the reported 0.570 m parking clearance is stored as a transparent reference height from the proxy lower-leg/base plane to the nozzle-end point.

legs.equivalent_guidance_model: Stage 3A tripod proxy: inclined ChLinkMatePrismatic main-leg guide, nonlinear compression-only TSDA main buffer, and two spherical-end elastic TSDA diagonal braces per footpad.

stage3_tripod_proxy.source: Thies 2022 Table 4 dimensions; tangential brace separation is an explicit geometry-closure assumption.

mechanism_elements_per_leg.long_brace: ChLinkTSDA spherical-end axial brace from T attachment to footpad center
mechanism_elements_per_leg.short_brace: ChLinkTSDA spherical-end axial brace from K attachment to footpad center

published_values: rocket mass, inertia, height, base diameter, CG and touchdown velocity from Thies 2022
leg count, leg length, leg angle and attachment heights from Thies 2022
damper linear stiffness/damping and reference stroke/force from Thies 2022
reported nozzle clearance 0.570 m from Thies 2022 Table 8
platform-support stiffness/damping transcribed from Thies 2022 Table 9
footpad radius and dynamic friction from Li 2025 where Thies does not publish them
tripod attachment heights T/K/B and strut lengths from Thies 2022 Table 4
nonlinear buffer base stiffness/damping from Thies 2022 Table 9
main-buffer nonlinear force-stroke and force-velocity curves digitized from Thies 2022 Figures 4 and 5
explicit_assumptions: four leg azimuths are symmetric at 45/135/225/315 deg because exact azimuths are not published
footpad mass is a transparent engineering placeholder until CAD or paper data is available
nozzle end location is represented by a Stage 3A proxy reference offset because CAD nozzle coordinates are not published
stage 1 uses a TSDA strut plus contact footpad model, not a full Adams-equivalent linkage
stage 1 constrains each footpad with a vertical prismatic mate instead of explicit tripod-link hinges
Chrono SMC Young modulus is set as an explicit contact-material assumption because Li reports contact stiffness/damping, not elastic modulus

Thies reports a platform mass-spring-damper coefficient, not a footpad/deck material law; applying those coefficients to each local SMC contact is a declared numerical proxy and requires stiffness/time-step sensitivity before load interpretation
Stage 3A uses axial TSDA links as spherical-end elastic braces; brace mass/inertia are not yet modeled as separate CAD rods.
Tangential separation of the two diagonal brace attachment points is set to 1.5 m because the supplied papers do not publish the full 3D CAD hinge coordinates.
The nonlinear buffer hard-stop stiffness/damping are numerical assumptions until a hydraulic or hydropneumatic force-stroke table is available.
Post-touchdown lock is currently a diagnostic stability flag and does not yet actuate a physical locking clamp.
Digitized Thies buffer law still uses a numerical hard-stop guard beyond the visible Figure 4 stroke range.

toppling_risk_diagnostic.method: CG projection inside the four-foot support polygon in the simplified Stage 3A geometry.

stable_standing_diagnostic.threshold_source: solver.post_touchdown_lock_logic engineering thresholds plus Thies nozzle clearance requirement

wrench_action_reaction.contact_application_point: Chrono spherical footpad center minus radius along the prescribed deck normal.
wrench_action_reaction.coordinate_frame: Chrono world axes aligned with the HAMS reference axes; moments are about the moving platform reference point; HAMS forces use linearized spatial axes.
wrench_action_reaction.sign_convention: Chrono contact and lock reactions act on the rocket/footpads. Platform generalized load is the equal and opposite [Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz].
wrench_action_reaction.resampling: Voronoi-bin means; trapezoidal resultant impulse preserved, not work
wrench_action_reaction.check_scope: algebraic assembly identity; not independent reaction measurement

coupling_work.reason: Independent contact-pair work requires actual contact-point forces, torques and velocities on both sides; the former origin/CG mixed proxy has been disabled.

absorber_work.definition: Trapezoidal integral of the recorded TSDA force with respect to recorded compression stroke; it includes recoverable and dissipative terms and is not relabelled as pure damping loss.

contact_impulse.definition: Legacy key retained for compatibility: time integral of max(world Fz,0), NOT deck-normal impulse; see projected_normal_impulse_ns for the new quantity.

rocket_energy.reason: Previous proxy mixed total vehicle mass with central-body velocity/inertia and omitted articulated-foot kinetic energy. No closed whole-vehicle energy claim is made.

platform_energy.definition: T_platform + U_hydrostatic; radiation energy is reported as negative radiation work proxy, not a hidden stored state

contact_model.source_note: In explicit Hooke mode Project Chrono multiplies material Gn by the contact-pair effective mass; Gn is therefore supplied in 1/s after converting the literature damping in N s/m.

mass_model.inertia_scope: Reference-pose mass/CG/tensor allocation is in config.rocket.review_reference_allocation; Child properties are assumed; this is not measured component inertia or CAD recovery.

plume_policy.load_definition: Wang 2023 plume_load_n waveform, including 506-510 s plateau approximation

deck_interpolation.state_consistency: position and supplied velocity are interpolated as one Hermite state pair

operator.radiation_memory_band_policy: The 0.2-2.0 rad/s positive-semidefinite active radiation band is used in the memory kernel; the separately computed 4-5 rad/s tail is used only for the finite-cutoff A_inf estimate.

added_mass_infinite_definition.method: mean of the last five computed added-mass matrices

operator.horizontal_dof_boundary: surge, sway and yaw are held fixed because supplied HAMS Hydrostatic.in has no horizontal restoring or mooring stiffness; no artificial horizontal stiffness is inserted
operator.hydrodynamic_grid_consistency: A(omega), B(omega), wave excitation and the finite-cutoff A_inf estimate are selected from the same completed mesh level.

ignored_platform_feedback.reason: No mooring/DP horizontal restoring data are available for the generated barge; their contact-wrench components are calculated and audited but not injected.
